payload.title: Global config-merge is additive-only and never prunes stale keys: ~/.fgos/config.json's setup…
payload.description: Global config-merge is additive-only and never prunes stale keys: ~/.fgos/config.json's setup config-merge writes/keeps old-schema tier-policy keys (e.g. lightweight/creative/analytical/critical under runner.modelPolicies.*) that a newer schema no longer defines, and never removes them. Confirmed real during the P05 selector-shadow-evaluation track (2026-09-20/21): historical-commit checkouts additively merged stale tier keys into this real, machine-level config file outside any repo, poisoning every subsequent fresh test fixture's default config on that machine and causing 200+ unrelated test failures until surgically fixed by hand. Fix belongs in the setup/config-merge subsystem (src/setup/checks.mjs or wherever config-merge is implemented): config-merge should prune keys no longer present in the current schema's defaults, not just add missing ones, or should validate/reject unknown keys on read. See plans/260920-immediate-test-feedback-reduction/reports/selector-shadow-evaluation.md for the full incident writeup.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
